High Lander reaches $30 million in total funding for drone-management platforms

The latest financing supports US expansion and development of Orion, Vega and Andromeda for operations and low-altitude airspace.

PR Newswire ↗19 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A cumulative funding milestone

High Lander said on October 19 that total funding had reached $30 million. The latest financing includes an additional strategic investment from EDGE Group and participation from STEP, Protego and Kinetica. The announcement does not separately disclose the size of the latest round.

Three software roles in aviation

Orion manages drone fleets, while Vega provides unmanned traffic management. Andromeda is presented as an AI operational-intelligence platform for a unified low-altitude airspace picture. The approach connects diverse systems and information; this announcement is not a launch of a new aircraft.

Expansion plans and their limits

The company plans to expand in the United States and other international markets, develop the three platforms and extend into security and dual-use applications. The release describes investment and product plans, rather than independent performance testing or guaranteed operating approval in every country.
